biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend opens a new Bellco checking account within 90 days of the referral email, deposits $250 at opening, and attaches a Visa debit card — and your friend must not already be on any Bellco checking account. A friend who doesn't meet all of this earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must: open a new Bellco checking account within 90 days of the referral email; deposit $250 at account opening; attach a Visa debit card; and not already be a tax/non-tax owner or signer on any Bellco checking account.
Friend must name your name/email at account opening; if multiple people referred them, only the named Advocate is paid.
No limit to how many rewards an Advocate can earn per year, but the program may be discontinued or changed at any time.
Rewards are fulfilled by third-party RMS via a redemption site; Bellco does not guarantee the redemption products.
Non-U.S. residents, individuals under 18, and Bellco employees (and their immediate household family members) are ineligible.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.

steps: Go to the Bellco Refer It Forward referral form at BellcoReferItForward.com (linked from bellco.org).
Fill out the referral form with your friend's email; they receive an invitation to open a Bellco checking account.
Your friend opens a new Bellco checking account within 90 days, deposits $250 at opening, attaches a Visa debit card, and names you as the referring Advocate.
Once all requirements are met, you receive a Unique Redemption Key to choose your $100 eGift Card from popular merchants.
timing: Reward earned after the referred person completes all checking requirements; Unique Redemption Key issued thereafter.
